How we build

We don't do feature creep. We ship.

Most software projects fail because they try to build everything at once. We build the workflow that makes you money first.

  1. Week1

    Operational discovery

    We sit with the people doing the work, map every manual step, find where data gets lost or re-typed, and write a short product spec you can read in ten minutes.

  2. Week2

    Backlog & first screens

    The spec becomes a prioritised backlog, a data model and clickable screens. You see how it will work before the real build starts.

  3. Week3

    Build & integrate

    We build the core modules, connect the services you already use (Razorpay, WhatsApp, Slack, your accounting tool) and finish the interface.

  4. Week4

    Testing & launch

    Mithila personally tests every flow and edge case before anything goes live. Then we hand over the production system and train your team on it.

Two kinds of project

Digital transformation

Meet the founder

The product brain behind the build.

Mithila Kannan is a senior product and delivery lead with over 11 years of experience designing and scaling high-volume platforms in B2B SaaS and fintech.

She started the studio to help early-stage founders and business owners close the gap between how their operations actually run and the clean software they need.

You won't be handed to a junior account manager. Mithila scopes every MVP herself, designs the logic and stays on the project until it's live.

Track record

Before the studio, inside payments, fintech and SaaS companies.

  • Payments · JapanLaunched a prepaid card product for a Japan-based payments platform.
  • Gaming · JP & KRRan digital gift-card programmes for gaming platforms across Japan and Korea.
  • Fintech strategyBuilt the 5-year financial forecast behind a new product line.
  • Data qualityCaught a revenue (GMV) miscalculation and an overstated activation metric before they reached leadership reports.
  • HR & payroll · IndiaEarlier, shipped HR and payroll software used by businesses across India.
The team behind the build

Mithila owns it. A full team builds it.

Every project has one owner from the first call to launch. Behind her is a team that gets the work done, so nothing waits on one person's calendar.

  • Forward-deployed engineersWork inside your operations to understand the real process and get the system adopted.
  • NLP & machine-learning data scientistsBuild the automation, document reading and predictions where data can do the work.
  • DevelopersBuild and integrate the web and mobile apps, payments and APIs.
  • DesignersMake the product simple enough for non-technical staff to use from day one.

Mithila scopes the work, writes the spec and signs off every release. The team designs, builds and ships it.
